# Validation Methodology

**Goal:** Prove the reward engine is accurate enough before shipping payment UI.  
**Status snapshot:** [status.md](status.md) (regenerated by CLI)

---

## Three layers

| Layer | Question | Source of truth | Pass criterion |
|-------|----------|-----------------|----------------|
| **L1 — Runtime data** | Do DB earn rules match Rewards CC reference? | `import-reference` → `carddata.db` | 20/20 cards: `validate-reference` green |
| **L2 — Ground truth** | Is reference still correct vs issuer + community? | Issuer pages + golden cases | ≥90% category rows verified |
| **L3 — Product behavior** | Does `recommend` pick the right card? | Golden wallet matrix | ≥95% scenarios match expected winner |

Live scrape alignment is **L2 evidence**, not L1. Runtime uses reference import at deploy time.

---

## Dimensions checked

- **Earn rules** — multipliers, categories, caps, dates per card
- **MCC coverage** — Visa MCC → spend category for Phase-1 categories
- **CPP** — `official_cpp.yaml` vs sources; see [architecture/official-cpp-valuation.md](../architecture/official-cpp-valuation.md)
- **Recommend ranking** — stable ordering; dollar value = points × official CPP
- **API surface** — 20 cards × standard CardData endpoints

---

## Commands

```bash
# Full run → reports/validation/*.json + docs/validation/status.md
credit-rewards-db validation-report

# Re-check gates only
credit-rewards-db validation-monitor-run

# Compare scrape vs reference
credit-rewards-db compare-all

# Web dashboard
uvicorn credit_rewards.web.app:app --port 8000
# → http://127.0.0.1:8000/validation
```

Payment UI ships when **validation `core_ready`** is true (all gates in [status.md](status.md) pass).  
As of 2026-06-07: **core_ready ✅** — payment UI unblocked.
